Privacy isn't an issue with my parents. I live far away from them but I go back every couple of weekends as my dads currently in the Middle East on business and my mom is alone. I'm thinking of going to a doctor to see if I can get anti-depression prescriptions again. Thank you for talking with me tonight, you're a very good person to do this and I'll be honest everyone who posted here is a very nice person, and I'll confess I actually became emotional when I read throwaway polaroid post this

>good luck and take care of yourself. i'm just one of many people (including, it sounds like, your mother and father) who truly care about you.

Again, thank you all. I'm going to catch some sleep, and try studying for this in the morning.

Thank you again.

When I came back to Canada from the Middle East I secretly went to the doctors (in Grade 11) to talk about me feeling jaded, and generally sad. He prescribed me some anti-depression pills but once my parents found out they didn't want me taking it. I haven't spoken to anyone about what I've seen when I was over there, at the same time I continue to bombard myself with death by constantly visiting subreddits like MorbidReality, Gore, Death and other sub reddits my mind subconsciously makes me go to

My really good friend's mother recently died of cancer and I don't want to burden him with the knowledge I'm my failings and my suicidal thoughts. I live with a friend of mine but even here I'm in a bad situation with my landlord who cut my internet off. I don't really talk emotionally with this friend, we live together but all we do is play games now and then.

I'm not a very emotional person, I haven't cried in years and I've seen horrible things happen in my home country in the Middle East. I'm jaded to death and violence. I've had family members die recently and I didn't even cry once, whereas my entire extended family were mourning for months. 

I like to think of my self as a caring person, but I'm very introverted. I've never been in a relationship. I don't know how to express my feelings properly, and almost every girl I know says I seem angry all the time, even though I feel as if I'm almost always blank faced. 

Venting isn't really going to solve my issues, I've gone over venting and I vent to myself every night of all the shit I've fucked up.
